column4: Copies a request's principal so a spawned cold fill can carry it to its publish check (src/gateway/meta_mcp/publish_gate.rs:82), its only use; the fill's own fetch never reads it. A wrong copy fails closed: the check reads that principal's grant, whose binding embeds its own account digest of authority and subject (src/personal_accounts/vault.rs:651-666, src/personal_accounts/mod.rs:54-63), so it can never equal the caller's binding, and the check answers Superseded and refuses the publish (src/gateway/meta_mcp/publish_gate.rs:52-60).

Borrows the owned principal back for the publish check's custody read (src/gateway/meta_mcp/publish_gate.rs:48), its only use. A wrong value fails closed for the same reason as `of`: another principal's binding embeds a different account digest (src/personal_accounts/vault.rs:651-666), so the check refuses the publish (src/gateway/meta_mcp/publish_gate.rs:52-60).
Returns the reason a custody read did not bind, used only for a debug log line; decides nothing.
